notes: The description and strategy say this non-flipping Court podracing deck went undefeated at the Atlanta DPC, with wins of 38, 27, 24 and 30 (4–0), and got him into the top 10; no placing is given. Since the DPC, Vader's Obsession and Young Fool replaced Main Course and a fourth Podracer Collision.

Format Premiere - Tatooine: the list is the pre-Coruscant DPC list (28 July 2001) with no Coruscant-set card. The post's 29 August 2001 update lists post-Coruscant changes and points to his later post Court Racer (Post-Coruscant); the list is kept as published.

No Starting section is posted; the strategy has the deck start the race with Start Your Engines! and start Watto's Box (Oppressive Enforcement instead against Podrace Prep). All 60 cards are in the posted sections.

Posted 'Boonta Eve Podrace', 'Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber' and 'Tatooine Podrace Arena' dested the Dark printings (the plain pages are Light); Oppressive Enforcement and Secret Plans are Effects in the 60, not shields.

Posted 'Omni Box & It's Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Start Your Engines' Start Your Engines!; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Weapon Levitation' the Dark Cloud City card; 'Twi'lek Advisor' x2 are the posted Grabbers.
player_note: The post says that since the DPC he swapped Main Course and a fourth Podracer Collision for Vader's Obsession and Young Fool.
